blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Inflation in the country accelerated to another three-year high of 7.2 percent in September, up from 6.1 percent in August, amid higher food and housing prices, the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) said on Tuesday. The latest print matched the rate recorded in April and snapped four consecutive months of easing.
